title: React Component Architect
description: Generate a fully typed, responsive React component with Tailwind CSS.
content: Create a React component named {{ComponentName}} using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. It should be fully responsive, accessible, and include Framer Motion for entrance animations. Include prop types and a clear, clean structure.
author: Dev Resource Hub

title: Next.js API Route Generator
description: Scaffold a secure Next.js App Router API endpoint.
content: Write a Next.js App Router API route (route.ts) for {{EndpointPurpose}}. Use standard try-catch error handling, validate incoming JSON using Zod, and return structured JSON responses with appropriate HTTP status codes.
author: Community

title: Fullstack App Initializer
description: Prompt an autonomous agent to build a full project foundation.
content: Initialize a new project using Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase. Set up the directory structure, install all dependencies, configure the Tailwind config for a dark theme, and create a basic auth page. Verify that the dev server runs without errors.
author: Dev Resource Hub
